headline: US Dollar Jumps on Fed Expectations

evidence.dominant_driver: Fed hike expectations reinforced by high oil prices, supporting the USD and pressuring duration-sensitive risk assets and precious metals.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: Reuters reported roughly 90% probability of a rate hike, up from around 60% one week earlier.

absorption.reason: The article itself describes an already-observed broad USD rally and existing pressure from oil/rates; forecast target is residual movement from decision time, not the initial reaction.

observations.oil: Brent around 107.61-108 and WTI around 102.53, elevated/up
observations.equities: European tech weak and US futures lower
observations.gold: already under pressure earlier in the session

evidence.decision_notes: Because this is a delayed market recap with low novelty, M2 discounts the headline and forecasts only residual move. No candidate-specific ACTIONABLE learning segment was used to override current facts; confidence remains moderate/low.

immediate.rationale: Strong USD and elevated yields remain bearish, but much of the move is already priced.

next_session.rationale: Fed/oil pressure remains bearish but geopolitical safe-haven demand creates two-sided risk.

15m.rationale: Cross-asset USD/rates confirmation still points lower from current levels.

1h.rationale: Headline is stale/partly priced and gold has competing safe-haven support.

4h.rationale: Residual bearish rate pressure competes with geopolitical demand.

next_session.rationale: Outcome increasingly depends on fresh Fed and Middle East news rather than this recap.

predictions.mechanism: Higher Fed hike pricing and stronger DXY raise the opportunity cost of non-yielding gold.
predictions.invalidation: A sharp drop in DXY/yields or fresh geopolitical escalation that dominates the rate channel.
predictions.counter_case: Gold could reverse higher if safe-haven flows overwhelm the stronger-dollar/rates channel.

immediate.rationale: USD/rates are bearish, but silver's industrial component and already-absorbed move reduce confidence.

predictions.invalidation: Dollar/yields reverse sharply or commodity/safe-haven demand strengthens.
predictions.counter_case: Silver can outperform if geopolitical demand or broader commodity buying accelerates.

predictions.invalidation: Treasury yields retreat materially and AI-risk sentiment reverses.
